title: A sound wave archive: res/sound/wave_archives/<category>/<name>/data.json
description: A wave archive's waves, 000.wav and on beside it, which tools/data/sound_data.py packs in the order of generated/sound_wave_archives.txt (tools/data/swar.py writes the archive). A WAV is 8-bit or 16-bit PCM, or IMA ADPCM as the game's own are; a wave archive with file uses another's.

file.description: The wave archive whose waves this one uses

waves.description: What each wave's WAV doesn't say, in the order of the WAV files: an empty object for a wave that plays once

loop_start.description: For a wave that loops, the sample its loop starts at; it loops to its end. A multiple of 8 for IMA ADPCM, 4 for 8-bit and 2 for 16-bit PCM

timer.description: The wave's playback timer, where it isn't its rate's (16756991 divided by the rate)
